offering_description.value: Provides secure transportation of cash and valuables, cash management and ATM services, and security solutions for businesses, banks, retailers and governments. Delivers through armored vehicles, secure facilities and technology-enabled services.

primary_products.value: security equipment; cash management hardware; ATM and vault systems

primary_services.value: cash-in-transit transportation; cash management services; ATM replenishment; secure logistics; global payments and digital banking services

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, retailers, casinos, jewelers, ATM operators, mobile payment and e-commerce firms; B2G: central banks and government agencies handling currency

end_markets.value: banking; retail; gaming and hospitality; government; ecommerce and payments

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for armored transport, cash logistics and ATM services; product sales: sales of security equipment and cash management hardware; transaction or usage fees: fees for payment and digital banking transactions
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in cash and valuables from clients and delivers them securely, sold to banks and retailers; software / platform: runs digital payment and banking platforms, sold to financial institutions and merchants

geography_served.value: global: operates in more than 50 countries across North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia Pacific and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: cash-in-transit, cash management, ATM services, security equipment and payment solutions sharing bank and retail customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving banks, retailers and government clients; own locations: secure depots, vaults and cash processing centers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed armored transport and money services regulated by national banking and financial regulators, plus data privacy rules

notes: Business segment details and current scope may have changed; some facet details are approximate.
